concepts.audienceInsight: Founders don't lack ideas; they lack the crew that turns an idea into a finished video.
concepts.pain: every video idea needs a whole crew they don't have
concepts.promise: you direct; a tiny studio on your desk does the production
concepts.creativeThesis: The crew you could never hire was waiting in a box on your desk.
concepts.visualMetaphor: a pop-up miniature film studio that unfolds on the founder's desk, with a tiny crew that builds sets and films
concepts.metaphorMapsTo: the engine's steps (script, cast, film, edit, check) become crew members doing physical jobs, and the founder's hand is the approval
concepts.productProof: three tiny productions (a UGC ad, an AI influencer clip, a mini-drama) come out finished and land in the founder's tray
concepts.openingHook: an oversized hand juggling too many paper app windows at once
concepts.objection: AI video looks fake: the crew checks every take before it leaves the studio
storyArc: a box unfolds into a studio
the founder hands over a script card
the crew films three kinds of video
concepts.brandReveal: the studio folds back into a small box whose lid is the brand card
concepts.rationale: The miniature world makes an abstract pipeline physical and lets the three video types appear as three visible productions, which is the proof.

concepts.audienceInsight: Founders want to taste and approve, not cook every dish themselves.
concepts.promise: a brigade prepares every video; you taste and approve
concepts.creativeThesis: Be the head chef, not the whole kitchen.
concepts.visualMetaphor: a busy restaurant kitchen where cooks plate videos like dishes and the founder tastes each one at the pass
concepts.metaphorMapsTo: stations are production steps; the pass is the approval gate; the order ticket is the locked budget
concepts.productProof: three plated dishes (ad, influencer clip, mini-drama) go out with a checked ticket
concepts.openingHook: a founder alone at ten burners, every pan smoking
concepts.objection: bad takes: nothing leaves the pass without the chef's yes
storyArc: the founder tastes at the pass
concepts.brandReveal: the restaurant's sign lights up at closing
concepts.rationale: Clear approval metaphor, but food may read as a food product and kitchens need many characters and hand work.

concepts.audienceInsight: Founders want control over what ships and what it costs.
concepts.pain: videos stuck on the ground while the founder does everything
concepts.promise: you clear each video for takeoff; the factory flies it
concepts.creativeThesis: Your job is clearing takeoffs, not building planes.
concepts.visualMetaphor: a tiny airport where finished videos taxi out as paper planes and the founder in the control tower clears each one
concepts.metaphorMapsTo: the tower is the approval gate, the runway length is the locked budget, ground crews are the per-take checks
concepts.productProof: three paper planes, each a different kind of video, take off one after another
concepts.openingHook: a runway jammed with half-built paper planes
concepts.objection: cost surprises: no plane leaves past the runway's end
concepts.brandReveal: planes write a trail that ends at the brand card
concepts.rationale: Strong control and budget story; weaker emotion, and flight shots invite fast motion that video models smear.

modeRationale: Story-driven: a brand launch for a creative tool, with no verified metrics to lead on; a character arc and a physical metaphor carry the proof better than a feature list.
